results.phase_payload_convention: phase i ends at exchange i; final phase follows the last exchange and has zero payload
results.fixture_semantics: unscaled integers: two signed one-hot entries, ternary weights/biases; dense random authenticated shares
results.device_incoming_assumption: all fixed incoming device frames preloaded before replay timing
results.ideal_timing_kind: estimate: sum of per-phase maxima of isolated-party medians
results.timing_boundary: resident private inputs/model through all checked intermediate openings and checked final output; preprocessing and private sharing excluded
results.methodology: Four roles execute independent authenticated Beaver arithmetic with ten keys by default. Every live run consumes fresh trusted correlations and fresh OS commitment salts. Separate untimed recording. Replay uses the recorded salts/correlations only for a fixed public fixture, while charging a fresh discarded OS entropy draw per salt; never serve live inputs from replay. Actual arithmetic, canonical validation, residual commitments, hashes, echoes and checks remain timed. Host replay includes host staging; device replay assumes incoming messages already on GPU. Both exclude network latency/bandwidth. Private input sharing recurs for new inputs; model sharing/preparation can be amortized. This is an integer square toy, not a transformer or fixed-point rescaling pipeline.
